boundary: A frozen-plan amendment of placement and nothing else.

capacity_fallback.note: an AZ-ordered retry was considered and NOT added: AWS named three zones with capacity, so ordering is sufficient, and a retry loop would have to be declared as a separate bounded policy rather than folded into the launch path

change.mechanism: the default subnets are ordered by declared zone preference and the launch refuses to proceed when no subnet sits in a permitted zone

job_it_applies_to: the readout re-run only, until a future job states otherwise
owner_instruction_raw: Approved: amend the resource plan to place the instance in an available AZ, and reserve a new $7.00 for the readout re-run.
reason: RunInstances for g7.2xlarge failed with InsufficientInstanceCapacity; the launcher had passed subnets[0], the first default subnet, which is in us-west-2d. AWS's error named us-west-2a, us-west-2b and us-west-2c as having capacity.
